global_secure_access._comment: Lab 34 policy. Endpoint lists and precedence are illustrative simplifications of Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access; check Microsoft Learn for current product behaviour.
global_secure_access.ca_internet_target: All internet resources with Global Secure Access

outcome_definitions.TUNNELED_MICROSOFT: Microsoft 365 and Entra traffic acquired by the Microsoft traffic profile.
outcome_definitions.TUNNELED_INTERNET_ALLOWED: Internet traffic acquired by the Internet Access profile and allowed by web content filtering.
outcome_definitions.BLOCKED_BY_WEB_FILTER: Internet traffic acquired and blocked by a web content filtering rule or a deny-by-default setting.
outcome_definitions.TUNNELED_PRIVATE_ACCESS: Private traffic matched to an assigned app's segment and sent through a healthy connector group.
outcome_definitions.BLOCKED_NO_SEGMENT: Private destination that no application segment available to the user covers.
outcome_definitions.BLOCKED_CONNECTOR_UNAVAILABLE: Matched app whose connector group is missing or has no healthy connector.
outcome_definitions.BYPASSED_NOT_FORWARDED: Traffic the client never acquires: no client, profile disabled or user not assigned.

concepts.traffic forwarding profile: A switch-and-assignment that tells the Global Secure Access client which class of traffic (Microsoft, internet or private) to send into the tunnel and for whom.
concepts.Global Secure Access client: Software on the device that captures traffic matching the enabled forwarding profiles and sends it to Microsoft's edge.
concepts.application segment: One destination definition in a Private Access app: an FQDN, wildcard FQDN, IP address or CIDR range plus ports and protocol.
concepts.connector group: A set of lightweight agents on the private network that carry Private Access traffic from Microsoft's edge to the internal resource.
concepts.Quick Access: A single broad Private Access app, often used to replace a VPN quickly, before splitting access into per-app enterprise applications.
concepts.web content filtering policy: An ordered list of allow or block rules matching web categories or FQDNs for internet traffic.
concepts.security profile: A prioritised container of filtering policies that Conditional Access links to users through a session control.
concepts.baseline profile: The lowest-priority security profile that applies to all forwarded internet traffic without any Conditional Access policy.
